tags.description:
To access the methods, use a token for the Finance category
Methods for getting: 1. Sales reports [list](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1SalesReportsList) and details for the reports by [IDs](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1SalesReportsDetailedReportId) and [period](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1SalesReportsDetailed) 2. Acquiring expenses reports [list](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1AcquiringList) and details for the reports by [IDs](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1AcquiringDetailedReportId) and [period](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/financialReports/operation/postV1AcquiringDetailed). The methods are available only for sellers from Russia
You can save the report in Google Sheets
tags.name: financialReports

tags.description:
To access the methods, use a token for the Documents category
Using these methods, you can get [seller documents](https://seller.wildberries.ru/supplementary-agreements) of various categories: acts, accounting reports, offers, letters, product lists, CCDs (Correction Calculation Documents), UPDs (Universal Transfer Documents), notifications, and so on.

To work with documents, first get the lists: 1. Of [document categories](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/documents/operation/getV1DocumentsCategories) 2. Of [seller documents](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/documents/operation/getV1DocumentsList) available for download Then you can download [a single document](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/documents/operation/getV1DocumentsDownload) or [multiple documents](./financial-reports-and-accounting#tag/documents/operation/postV1DocumentsDownloadAll) from the list.
tags.name: documents
